Leading with science, technology 
and human ingenuity to innovate 
in life sciences
The world is undergoing rapid and structural change and PI is responding with clarity of purpose and 
agility of execution. Geopolitical realignments, climate pressures and advances in artificial intelligence 
and biology are redefining the life sciences landscape. In this context, PI enters its 80 th year with a clear 
ambition, to pioneer innovation in life sciences from India to the world. 
PI’s journey reflects a deliberate, science-led transition from an agrisciences foundation to a globally 
relevant life sciences enterprise. Built on decades of capability in complex chemistry, process engineering 
and trusted global partnerships, the Company has evolved into a more integrated, end-to-end operating 
model. This evolution marks a defining shift, from being a participant in global value chains to becoming 
an increasingly important originator of innovation, with India at its core and the world as its market.
We are pleased to present our Integrated Annual Report for FY 2025-26, marking the fourth edition of 
PI’s integrated reporting journey and offering a unified account of how PI creates, preserves and shares 
value across financial, social and environmental dimensions. This report captures the essence of our 
80-year journey, driven by curiosity, guided by integrity and propelled by a relentless pursuit of innovation 
that translates science into real-world impact.

PI’s journey reflects the emergence of India as a global 
innovation hub in life sciences, shaped by scientific 
depth, execution capability and an increasingly central 
role in global value chains. What began as a strong 
foundation in AgChem has evolved into a broader life 
sciences enterprise anchored in research, innovation 
and global partnerships across the value chain. This 
transformation represents a shift from product-led 
growth to solution-driven innovation across agriculture 
and allied life sciences domains with India as the centre 
of scientific origination and the world as the market.
This evolution reflects a broader shift underway in 
Indian industry from scale and manufacturing capability 
to global scientific leadership, where innovation is 
conceptualised, developed and commercialised from 
India. 
At the same time, geopolitical realignments and shifting 
trade dynamics reshaped sourcing strategies and 
cross-border collaboration, reinforcing the importance 
of supply chain resilience and diversification. In parallel, 
climate variability, changing weather patterns and 
increasing regulatory scrutiny placed agriculture at the 
forefront of both risk and innovation, accelerating the 
need for sustainable and productivity-enhancing life 
sciences solutions.
Within this context, PI continued to strengthen its 
focus on innovation-led growth. Its integrated model, 
spanning advanced research and development, 
scale-up capabilities and manufacturing excellence, 
supported responsiveness to market volatility while 
building future-ready capabilities. Investments in 
digitalisation, advanced chemistry, emerging biology-
led platforms and responsible supply chain practices 
further enhanced the Company’s ability to deliver 
differentiated solutions. As agricultural systems 
evolve through shifting crop patterns, rising input 
costs and increasing sustainability expectations, 
While keeping the customer in the centre PI’s 
science-based approach and long-term partnerships 
with global innovators continue to reinforce 
its relevance.
PI’s progression also reflects a broader shift underway 
in Indian industry from capability to global leadership. 
While India has long been recognised for scale and 
process expertise, it is now expanding its role as 
a centre for scientific innovation. PI stands at the 
forefront of this transition, contributing across the 
lifecycle of innovation, from molecule discovery and 
process development to commercial-scale delivery. 
Deep capabilities in complex chemistry, molecular 
design and process engineering position the company 
within global innovation ecosystems rather than at 
their periphery.
From its base in India, PI engages with some of the 
world’s most advanced markets, delivering to the 
highest standards of quality, compliance and precision. 
Its operating model integrates scientific innovation with 
execution capability, enabling outcomes that are both 
globally relevant and consistently delivered at scale.
Biologicals are becoming central to the future of 
farming, helping farmers protect their crops sustainably 
by improving plant health and yield while lowering 
environmental impact. PI has been at the forefront 
of this shift, with a presence in biologicals in India 
spanning close to two decades and is today creating 
solutions for global crop protection. A platform, built 
on peptides derived from natural proteins, offers an 
environmentally friendly way to stimulate crop growth, 
improve disease control, plant health and yield.
 
This transition is exemplified by the development of 
Pioxaniliprole, PI’s proprietary New Chemical Entity 
(NCE) and the first insecticide molecule from an Indian 
company to receive ISO approval.
Beyond this milestone, PI is advancing a steadily 
evolving pipeline of molecules and solutions for the 
world, spanning the journey from discovery to delivery. 
Anchored by an integrated research ecosystem and 
the depth of its scientific talent, PI turns discovery from 
India into innovation that reaches farmers and partners 
across the globe.
Beyond a product milestone, it represents a structural 
shift in India’s innovation capability, demonstrating 
the ability to originate science locally and deliver it to 
global markets at the highest standards of regulatory 
and scientific rigour. 
Looking ahead, PI is entering its next phase of growth 
with a clear shift towards an innovator mindset. In agri-
sciences, the focus is on taking new active ingredients to 
global markets. In life sciences, the company is building 
a scaled pharma Contract Research, Development 
and Manufacturing Organizations (CRDMO) platform, 
while also expanding into adjacent domains such as 
electronic chemicals. This broadening of its scientific 
and business canvas creates multiple pathways for 
growth across sectors and geographies.
PI’s plans are supported by a strong balance sheet, 
robust technological capabilities and globally integrated

The Integrated Report has been prepared with reference 
to the Global Reporting Initiative GRI Standards and 
the requirements of Business Responsibility and 
Sustainability Reporting issued by the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (SEBI).
This Integrated Report presents the operational and 
strategic performance of PI Industries Limited for the 
financial year 2025–26 (April 1, 2025 to March 31, 
2026). It covers both standalone and consolidated 
operations, with PI Industries Limited as the primary 
financial reporting entity, registered in India and listed 
on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay 
Stock Exchange (BSE). In cases where information 
extends beyond predefined parameters, explicit 
conditions are established to ensure transparency and 
consistency in reporting.
In continuation with FY 2024-25 approach, the report 
includes Jivagro Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary. 
Sustainability data is presented in line with Global 
Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards, with operational 
alignment between the two mentioned entities. 
Our reporting boundary remains the same as last year 
for the Integrated Report and BRSR respectively. 
BRSR reporting is on standalone operations of PI 
Industries Limited which specifically includes five 
manufacturing locations in Gujarat (three in Panoli and 
two in Jambusar), four corporate offices (Gurugram, 
Mumbai and two in Vadodara), two R&D centres 
(Udaipur and Hyderabad), eight depots and three 
guest houses (Delhi, Vadodara and Udaipur).
In alignment with Pioneering Innovation in Life Sciences: 
From India to the World, this report underscores our 
commitment to responsibly applying science and 
innovation to improve outcomes for our customers, 
communities and planet. 
The disclosure of key initiatives and performance 
indicators is structured based on the material topics 
identified, following a comprehensive evaluation 
conducted in collaboration with key stakeholders. The 
identified challenges, business risks, opportunities, 
(including climate-related risks and opportunities) 
and impacts are material to PI Industries Limited’s 
long-term value creation for its stakeholders and 
broader society.
By integrating financial and sustainability disclosures, 
this report reinforces stakeholder trust and offers a 
forward-looking perspective on how PI is building 
sustainable, long-term value for shareholders and 
society alike.
